label: Which nets to rip up
subgoals: Count each edge's demand from the routes
Find the edges whose demand exceeds capacity
Rip up the nets that use any overflowed edge

label: Reroute ordering
subgoals: Sort them by the chosen rule, such as bounding-box half-perimeter
Reroute them in that order on the updated costs

label: Measuring a reroute
subgoals: Remove the net's demand from its old edges
Add its demand to the new edges
Recompute total overflow and keep the change only if it helps
